description: Verification activities with acceptance criteria where established.

records.title: Stair capacity and evacuation assessment
records.conditions: Population and evacuation strategy as defined in the building fire strategy (FDOC-001).
records.acceptance_criterion: Stair capacity is not less than the evacuating population determined under the agreed fire strategy

records.title: Fire alarm cause-and-effect functional test
records.conditions: All zones, against the matrix in FDOC-002.
records.acceptance_criterion: Every initiating device produces the outputs specified in the approved cause-and-effect matrix

records.title: Detection and alarm inspection within the flats
records.conditions: No grade or category of system has been selected for the flats.

records.title: Stair lobby fire doorset inspection
records.acceptance_criterion: Doorsets carry third-party certification for their specified fire and smoke performance, and self-closing devices close and latch the door

records.title: Compartment floor fire-resistance evidence review
records.acceptance_criterion: As-built construction matches a tested or assessed specification achieving the fire resistance period stated in the fire strategy

records.title: Flat entrance doorset specification and certification review
records.acceptance_criterion: Doorsets are certified for the fire resistance and smoke control performance the fire strategy specifies for flat entrance doors

records.title: Sprinkler provision assessment for Level 3
records.conditions: Scope depends on the evacuation strategy and building height, neither recorded.

records.title: Fire service access route survey to Level 3
records.conditions: Fire appliance access, entry point and route to Level 3.
records.acceptance_criterion: Access route and firefighting facilities conform to the fire service provisions recorded in the fire strategy

records.title: Dry rising main pressure test
records.conditions: Existing dry rising main serving all storeys.
records.acceptance_criterion: Rising main holds test pressure for the duration specified by its installation standard with no loss of pressure
